🏛️ Government spent R2.52 trillion in 2024/25, R126.8 billion more than the year before.

📚 Education got the most of any single area: R509 billion (20%).
💸 Debt costs took R386 billion (15%), about R1.1 billion a day and almost as much as social protection (R387 billion).
📈 Debt's share of spending has risen from 8.4% to 15.3% in ten years.

Source: Stats SA, Financial statistics of consolidated general government 2024/2025.
Education, not financial advice.
